title: Kanda Poha (Maharashtrian Tempered Flattened Rice)

steps.title: Rinse Poha
steps.instruction: Rinse thick poha in a strainer under cold water for 30 seconds. Drain, toss with 1/2 tsp salt and sugar, and let rest.
steps.tip: Do not soak poha in a bowl or it will become mushy.

steps.title: Fry Peanuts & Phodni
steps.instruction: Heat oil in kadai. Fry peanuts till crunchy and remove. In same oil, splutter mustard seeds, green chillies, and curry leaves.
steps.tip: Frying peanuts first preserves their crispness.

steps.title: Sauté Onions
steps.instruction: Add chopped onions and sauté until translucent and soft. Stir in turmeric powder.
steps.tip: Do not brown the onions; they should stay soft and sweet.

steps.title: Combine & Steam
steps.instruction: Add the softened poha and fried peanuts. Toss gently. Sprinkle 1 tbsp water, cover with lid, and steam on low for 2 mins.
steps.tip: Use a light folding motion.

steps.title: Garnish & Serve
steps.instruction: Turn off flame, drizzle lemon juice, and garnish with fresh coriander and grated coconut.
steps.tip: Serve steaming hot with Masala Chai.

summary: Fluffy tempered flattened rice tossed with golden onions, crisp peanuts, mustard, curry leaves, and lemon.

title: Phodnichi Poli (Maharashtrian Spiced Leftover Chapati)

steps.title: Tear Chapatis
steps.instruction: Tear stale chapatis into small bite-sized pieces. Sprinkle 2 tbsp of water over them to soften slightly.
steps.tip: Sprinkling water prevents the stale roti from turning rock hard during cooking.

steps.title: Prepare Phodni
steps.instruction: Heat oil in kadai. Fry peanuts until crispy. Add mustard, cumin, curry leaves, and green chillies.
steps.tip: Let mustard crackle completely.

steps.title: Sauté Onion & Turmeric
steps.instruction: Add chopped onions and sauté until pink. Add turmeric and salt.
steps.tip: Remember chapati already has some salt, so add salt moderately.

steps.title: Toss and Steam
steps.instruction: Add torn chapati pieces, toss thoroughly, cover with lid and steam on low flame for 3 minutes.
steps.tip: Steaming makes the chapatis delightfully soft and chewy.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Squeeze fresh lemon juice and garnish with coriander.
steps.tip: Use the listed ingredients as the visual cue for this step of Phodnichi Poli.

summary: Classic Maharashtrian breakfast transforming stale rotis into a flavorful, soft and tangy spiced hash with peanuts and curry leaves.

title: Phodnicha Bhaat (Maharashtrian Tempered Leftover Rice)

steps.title: Fluff Rice
steps.instruction: Gently break lumps in cold leftover rice using clean wet fingers.
steps.tip: Cold refrigerated rice stays intact without becoming sticky.

steps.title: Tempering (Phodni)
steps.instruction: Heat oil/ghee in pan. Fry peanuts till golden. Add mustard, cumin, hing, green chillies, and curry leaves.
steps.tip: Hing in ghee gives the signature traditional aroma.

steps.title: Sauté Onion & Spices
steps.instruction: Add sliced onions and sauté till light golden. Add turmeric and salt.
steps.tip: Golden onions give slight sweetness.

steps.title: Toss and Heat Through
steps.instruction: Add cold rice, mix well with tempering, cover and steam for 2-3 mins on low flame. Garnish with coriander.
steps.tip: Serve warm with curd or roasted papad.

summary: Crispy tempered aromatic rice seasoned with mustard, turmeric, peanuts, and golden onions.

title: Bharli Vangi (Maharashtrian Stuffed Baby Eggplants in Peanut Coconut Gravy)

steps.title: Slit Brinjals
steps.instruction: Slit baby brinjals in a '+' cross shape keeping the stem intact. Place in salted water to prevent blackening.
steps.tip: Keeping the crown stem makes them look royal.

steps.title: Make Stuffing Masala
steps.instruction: In a bowl, mix roasted peanut powder, toasted dry coconut, goda masala, red chilli powder, turmeric, ginger-garlic paste, jaggery, tamarind, salt, and 1 tbsp oil.
steps.tip: Taste the dry masala; it should be robust, nutty, spicy, and mildly sweet.

steps.title: Stuff Brinjals
steps.instruction: Generously stuff each brinjal with the peanut masala. Reserve leftover masala for gravy.
steps.tip: Pack it tightly into the slit crevices.

steps.title: Cook Gravy
steps.instruction: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pan. Splutter mustard, cumin, and curry leaves. Place stuffed brinjals gently, cover and sear for 5 mins.
steps.tip: Searing the skins brings out a wonderful roasted aroma.

steps.title: Simmer to Perfection
steps.instruction: Add the remaining stuffing masala and 1 cup warm water. Cover and simmer on low flame for 15 minutes until brinjals are melt-in-the-mouth tender and oil separates on top. Garnish with coriander.
steps.tip: Keep the simmer gentle and stop when the main ingredients reach the texture described for Bharli Vangi.

summary: Royal Maharashtrian curry of tender baby brinjals stuffed with a nutty roasted peanut, toasted coconut, and aromatic Goda Masala spice paste.

title: Maharashtrian Pithla (Comforting Spiced Besan Curry)

steps.title: Whisk Besan Slurry
steps.instruction: Whisk besan with 2 cups water, salt, and turmeric in a bowl until completely lump-free.
steps.tip: Ensure zero lumps for a velvety texture.

steps.title: Tempering & Aromatics
steps.instruction: Heat oil in kadai. Splutter mustard, cumin, hing, and curry leaves. Add crushed garlic and green chillies; sauté till aromatic.
steps.tip: Crushing garlic in mortar-pestle yields the best rustic flavor.

steps.title: Sauté Onions
steps.instruction: Add sliced onions and fry till soft and slightly golden.
steps.tip: Generous onions make Pithla sweet and flavorful.

steps.title: Pour and Whisk Continuously
steps.instruction: Lower flame, pour besan slurry while stirring continuously with a spatula to prevent lumps.
steps.tip: Keep stirring until it thickens smoothly.

steps.title: Steam and Garnish
steps.instruction: Cover with lid and steam on lowest flame for 4 minutes until glossy and fragrant. Top with fresh coriander.
steps.tip: Serve bubbling hot with Jowar Bhakri, Shengdana Chutney, and Raw Onion.

summary: Rustic Maharashtrian soul food made of creamy tempered besan spiced with crushed garlic, green chillies, and onions.

title: Authentic Puneri / Kolhapuri Misal Pav (Spiced Sprouted Moth Bean Curry)

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.unit: medium (1 sliced for paste, 1 chopped for garnish)

steps.title: Make Vatan Paste
steps.instruction: Roast sliced onion and dry coconut in 1 tsp oil until dark brown. Blend with ginger, garlic, and tomato into a smooth paste (Vatan).
steps.tip: Deep roasting gives Misal its trademark smoky flavor.

steps.title: Cook Sprouted Matki
steps.instruction: Boil sprouted matki in salted water with a pinch of turmeric for 5-7 mins until tender but not mushy.
steps.tip: Do not overcook the sprouts.

steps.title: Fry Masala & Create Tari (Kat)
steps.instruction: Heat 3 tbsp oil. Add Vatan paste and sauté till oil oozes out. Add Goda masala and Kashmiri chilli powder.
steps.tip: Adequate oil creates the signature fiery red 'Tari' float.

steps.title: Simmer Gravy
steps.instruction: Add boiled matki along with its water. Add 2 cups hot water and salt. Simmer vigorously for 10 mins.
steps.tip: The liquid should be thin and intensely spiced.

steps.title: Assemble Misal
steps.instruction: In a shallow bowl, add boiled matki base, ladle boiling red Tari on top, heap crunchy farsan, chopped raw onions, coriander, and squeeze lemon. Serve with buttered Pav.
steps.tip: Enjoy the fiery layers of crunch and spice!

summary: Legendary Maharashtrian street delicacy featuring spiced sprouted moth beans topped with fiery red Tari broth, crunchy farsan, onions, and pav.

title: Maharashtrian Multi-Grain Thalipeeth (Spiced Flatbread)

ingredients.name: Bhajani Flour (or mix of Jowar, Besan, Rice, Wheat flour)
substitutes: Equal parts Jowar + Besan + Wheat flour

steps.title: Knead Dough
steps.instruction: In a bowl, mix Bhajani flour, chopped onion, coriander, chilli-garlic paste, ajwain, sesame seeds, turmeric, chilli powder, and salt. Knead with warm water into a soft pliable dough.
steps.tip: Dough should be soft enough to pat flat with moist fingers.

steps.title: Pat onto Tawa or Parchment
steps.instruction: Grease a cold tawa or parchment paper. Place a ball of dough and pat into a round disc using wet fingers. Make 3-4 small holes in the center.
steps.tip: Holes allow oil/butter to circulate and cook evenly from inside.

steps.title: Roast with Ghee/Oil
steps.instruction: Place tawa on medium flame. Drizzle oil or ghee into the holes and around edges. Cover with lid and roast for 3 mins.
steps.tip: Covering steams the center while crisping the base.

steps.title: Flip and Crisp
steps.instruction: Flip and roast the other side until crispy golden brown spots appear.
steps.tip: Serve piping hot with fresh white butter (Loni), curd, and spicy thecha.

summary: Wholesome roasted multigrain flatbread packed with roasted lentils, onions, sesame, ajwain, and fresh coriander.

title: Non-Sticky Sabudana Khichdi (Upwas / Fasting Speciality)

ingredients.name: Sendha Namak (Rock Salt or regular salt)

steps.title: Soak & Coat Sabudana
steps.instruction: Ensure sabudana is soaked for 5 hours with just enough water to submerge, then fluffed dry. Toss with coarse peanut powder, salt, and sugar.
steps.tip: Coating sabudana in peanut powder before cooking guarantees pearls won't stick together!

steps.title: Tempering in Ghee
steps.instruction: Heat ghee in pan. Add cumin seeds and green chillies. Sauté diced potatoes until golden and tender.
steps.tip: Ghee delivers the ultimate fasting aroma.

steps.title: Toss and Steam Pearls
steps.instruction: Add the peanut-coated sabudana mixture. Toss gently on medium-low flame. Cover with lid and steam for 3-4 mins until pearls turn translucent.
steps.tip: Do not overcook or pearls become chewy.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Turn off heat, squeeze fresh lemon juice, and garnish with coriander.
steps.tip: Serve warm with cool spiced curd.

summary: Fluffy, non-sticky translucent tapioca pearls tossed with crunchy roasted peanuts, green chillies, cumin, and potatoes in pure ghee.

title: Mumbai / Maharashtrian Batata Vada (Spiced Potato Fritters)

steps.title: Prepare Potato Masala
steps.instruction: Heat 1 tbsp oil in pan. Splutter mustard, hing, curry leaves, ginger-garlic-chilli paste, and turmeric. Pour over mashed boiled potatoes. Add salt, coriander, lemon juice, and mix well.
steps.tip: Do not make potatoes too wet; let cool.

steps.title: Shape Balls
steps.instruction: Divide potato mixture into equal round lemon-sized balls.
steps.tip: Smooth balls coat evenly in batter.

steps.title: Make Crispy Batter
steps.instruction: Whisk besan, rice flour, turmeric, pinch of salt, pinch of baking soda, and 1 tbsp hot oil with water to form a smooth pouring batter.
steps.tip: A drop of hot oil in the batter ensures crispy golden coating.

steps.title: Dip and Fry
steps.instruction: Heat oil in deep kadai. Dip each potato ball in batter, slide gently into hot oil, and deep fry till crisp and golden.
steps.tip: Keep the heat steady and watch the surface of Mumbai / Maharashtrian Batata Vada for even browning.

summary: Golden, crunchy besan-crusted fritters stuffed with a fiery turmeric, garlic, mustard and curry-leaf spiced potato filling.

title: Crispy Maharashtrian Kothimbir Vadi (Steamed & Pan-Crisped Coriander Cakes)

steps.title: Make Dough/Batter
steps.instruction: Mix dry chopped coriander, besan, rice flour, spices, ginger-garlic-chilli paste, sesame seeds, lemon juice, salt, and knead with minimal water into a tight cylindrical roll.
steps.tip: Coriander releases moisture, so add water 1 tsp at a time.

steps.title: Steam
steps.instruction: Place cylinder rolls in a greased steamer plate and steam for 15 minutes until a knife inserted comes out clean.
steps.tip: Let cool completely before slicing.

steps.title: Slice
steps.instruction: Cut steamed roll into 1/2 inch thick square or diagonal vadis.
steps.tip: Cooling prevents crumbling while slicing.

steps.title: Pan-Crisp / Fry
steps.instruction: Shallow fry or pan-toast in hot oil on medium flame until golden crisp on both sides.
steps.tip: Keep the heat steady and watch the surface of Crispy Maharashtrian Kothimbir Vadi for even browning.

summary: Savory steamed and crisp-toasted coriander besan cakes topped with toasted sesame seeds.

title: Sada Varan Bhaat with Shuddha Toop (Pure Maharashtrian Comfort Meal)

steps.title: Pressure Cook Dal
steps.instruction: Wash toor dal, add 2.5 cups water, turmeric, and pinch of hing. Pressure cook for 4 whistles until completely soft.
steps.tip: Indrayani rice cooked with dal gives heavenly fragrant softness.

steps.title: Mash & Season
steps.instruction: Whisk hot cooked dal with a wooden churner (Ravi) until silky. Add salt, jaggery, 1/2 cup water and simmer for 5 mins.
steps.tip: Traditional Sada Varan is unspiced to let the natural sweetness of toor dal shine.

steps.title: Serve with Toop
steps.instruction: Mound steaming hot rice on a plate, make a well in the center, ladle creamy varan, top with a generous spoonful of pure homemade ghee, and squeeze fresh lemon.
steps.tip: Keep the lid closed during steaming so Sada Varan Bhaat with Shuddha Toop cooks evenly.

summary: The quintessential Maharashtrian comfort meal of silky boiled toor dal poured over fragrant steaming rice with pure golden ghee and lemon.

title: Katachi Amti (Spicy Tangy Chana Dal Broth for Puran Poli)

steps.title: Prepare Amti Base
steps.instruction: Boil chana dal and strain the clear stock (Kat). Reserve 2 tbsp cooked dal and mash it with 2 tbsp roasted coconut-onion paste.
steps.tip: The kat provides clarity while mashed dal adds body.

steps.title: Tempering (Phodni)
steps.instruction: Heat oil/ghee. Splutter mustard, cumin, hing, and curry leaves. Add red chilli powder and Goda Masala.
steps.tip: Keep heat low so spices bloom without burning.

steps.title: Simmer Broth
steps.instruction: Pour the dal stock and mashed dal paste. Add tamarind pulp, jaggery, salt, and bring to a rolling boil.
steps.tip: Simmer for at least 10 minutes for flavors to marry.

steps.title: Garnish
steps.instruction: Garnish with chopped fresh coriander. Serve hot with Puran Poli or steamed rice.
steps.tip: The interplay of sweet jaggery, tart tamarind, and spicy goda masala is magical.

summary: Aromatic, tangy, sweet, and spicy Maharashtrian festive broth made from strained chana dal stock with tamarind, jaggery, and Goda Masala.

title: Konkani Solkadhi (Refreshing Kokum & Fresh Coconut Milk Digestive Drink)

ingredients.name: Kokum (Amsul)
ingredients.unit: petals, soaked in 1/2 cup warm water

steps.title: Extract Coconut Milk
steps.instruction: Grind fresh coconut with garlic, green chilli, cumin seeds, and 1 cup warm water. Strain through a fine muslin cloth to extract thick rich milk. Repeat once with 1/2 cup water for second extract.
steps.tip: Warm water extracts higher fat and cream from coconut.

steps.title: Extract Kokum Essence (Agal)
steps.instruction: Squeeze soaked kokum petals thoroughly to extract vibrant purple tangy extract. Strain into the coconut milk.
steps.tip: Watch the white coconut milk blush into a gorgeous pastel pink!

steps.title: Season & Chill
steps.instruction: Add salt, rock salt, and finely chopped coriander. Stir gently and chill in refrigerator for 20 mins before serving.
steps.tip: Do not boil or heat Solkadhi; it is served cold.

summary: Pink Konkani elixir made of fresh creamy coconut milk infused with tangy kokum petals, garlic, green chilli, and cumin.

title: Spiced Leftover Dal Paratha (Missi Roti Style)

steps.title: Knead Dal Dough
steps.instruction: In a large bowl, combine wheat flour, leftover dal, onion, green chillies, ajwain, kasuri methi, coriander, and salt. Knead into a smooth soft dough without adding extra water.
steps.tip: Dal makes the dough exceptionally soft and protein-rich.

steps.title: Roll Parathas
steps.instruction: Divide dough into equal balls. Dust with flour and roll into 7-inch round parathas.
steps.tip: Roll gently so onions don't tear the edges.

steps.title: Roast on Tawa
steps.instruction: Heat tawa on medium-high. Place paratha and cook for 1 min until bubbles appear. Flip, brush with ghee, flip again and press edges until golden crisp spots develop.
steps.tip: Serve hot with curd, butter, and pickle.

summary: Flaky, ultra-soft parathas made by kneading leftover dal directly into whole wheat flour with ajwain and kasuri methi.

title: Maharashtrian Chakolya / Varan Phal (Spiced Wheat Dumplings Simmered in Dal)

ingredients.name: Leftover Dal or Boiled Toor Dal

steps.title: Knead Wheat Dough & Cut Diamonds
steps.instruction: Knead wheat flour with salt, ajwain, turmeric, and 1 tsp oil into a firm dough. Roll out thin into a large roti and cut into diamond strips (phal).
steps.tip: Rolling thin ensures dumplings cook quickly and evenly.

steps.title: Prepare Boiling Dal Base
steps.instruction: In a pot, heat ghee, splutter mustard, cumin, hing, curry leaves, and peanuts. Add leftover dal, 2 cups water, goda masala, chilli powder, kokum, jaggery, and salt. Bring to a rolling boil.
steps.tip: Dal must be boiling vigorously before dropping dumplings.

steps.title: Drop Diamonds and Simmer
steps.instruction: Drop wheat diamond strips one by one into the boiling dal so they don't stick. Cover and cook on medium flame for 10-12 minutes until dumplings float and are cooked through.
steps.tip: The starch from dumplings thickens the dal broth into pure comfort.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Ladle into deep bowls, drizzle warm ghee on top, and garnish with fresh coriander.
steps.tip: One-pot Indian pasta comfort at its best.

summary: Hearty Maharashtrian one-pot meal of spiced whole wheat diamond dumplings simmered in bubbling tangy-sweet toor dal.

title: Maharashtrian Sweet & Tangy Kadhi (Tempered Buttermilk Soup)

steps.title: Whisk Curd and Besan
steps.instruction: Whisk sour curd, besan, water, ginger-green chilli paste, jaggery, and salt until completely smooth.
steps.tip: Thorough whisking prevents curd from curdling when heated.

steps.title: Ghee Phodni (Tempering)
steps.instruction: Heat ghee in saucepan. Add cloves, cinnamon, mustard, cumin, hing, and curry leaves.
steps.tip: Whole cloves and cinnamon give Maharashtrian kadhi its distinct aromatic charm.

steps.title: Simmer on Low Flame
steps.instruction: Pour the whisked curd mixture into the pan. Stir continuously over medium-low flame until it comes to a single gentle simmer.
steps.tip: Do not boil violently or leave unattended to prevent splitting.

steps.title: Garnish
steps.instruction: Turn off flame, top with fresh coriander, and serve with steaming hot Khichdi.
steps.tip: Pair with Moong Dal Khichdi for ultimate digestive warmth.

summary: Delicate, sweet and tangy Maharashtrian curd curry tempered with aromatic cloves, cinnamon, mustard, and pure ghee.

title: Spiced Bread Upma (Phodnicha Bread)

steps.title: Cube Bread
steps.instruction: Cut stale bread or pav into bite-sized 1-inch cubes.
steps.tip: Slightly stale bread absorbs spices without turning soggy.

steps.title: Tempering & Veggies
steps.instruction: Heat oil in kadai. Fry peanuts till crisp. Add mustard, cumin, curry leaves, chillies, and onions. Sauté till soft, then add chopped tomatoes, turmeric, chilli powder, and salt.
steps.tip: Cook tomatoes till soft and mushy to form a rich sauce.

steps.title: Toss Bread
steps.instruction: Sprinkle 1 tbsp water on tomatoes to create slight steam, immediately add bread cubes and toss gently until every piece is coated.
steps.tip: Toss quickly on high flame to keep outer edges crisp.

steps.title: Garnish
steps.instruction: Squeeze lemon juice, garnish with coriander and sev. Serve immediately.
steps.tip: Delicious tea-time snack ready in minutes.

summary: Tangy and spicy snack of cubed bread tossed with golden onions, juicy tomatoes, crunchy peanuts, and mustard tempering.

title: Dhabha-Style Dahi Tadka (Garlic-Tempered Curd Bowl)

steps.title: Whisk Curd
steps.instruction: Whisk thick curd with salt in a serving bowl until smooth and creamy.
steps.tip: Keep curd at room temperature so the hot tadka doesn't cause drastic temperature shock.

steps.title: Sizzle Sizzling Tadka
steps.instruction: Heat ghee in a tadka pan. Add cumin, mustard, whole red chillies, sliced garlic, and chopped onions. Fry until garlic turns fragrant and golden brown.
steps.tip: Golden fried garlic is the hero of this dish.

steps.title: Add Spices & Pour
steps.instruction: Turn off flame, immediately add Kashmiri chilli powder, hing, and crushed kasuri methi. Pour the sizzling hot tadka directly over the beaten curd.
steps.tip: Do not stir completely; let the fiery red oil swirl over the cool white curd.

steps.title: Serve
steps.instruction: Garnish with fresh coriander and serve immediately with hot parathas or roti.
steps.tip: A 5-minute lifesaver when no vegetables are in the house!

summary: Creamy whipped curd crowned with a sizzling, fragrant tempering of golden garlic, Kashmiri red chilli, cumin, and ghee.

title: Temple Style Curd Rice (Daddojanam / Dahi Bhaat)

steps.title: Mash Rice with Curd and Milk
steps.instruction: In a bowl, lightly mash soft cooked rice with back of a spoon. Mix in fresh curd, milk, and salt until luscious and creamy.
steps.tip: Adding a splash of milk prevents curd rice from turning overly sour if kept for a few hours.

steps.title: Prepare South Indian Tadka
steps.instruction: Heat ghee/oil in a small pan. Add mustard seeds, urad dal, chana dal and fry until golden. Add minced ginger, green chillies, curry leaves, and hing.
steps.tip: Crunchy golden lentils give the iconic bite.

steps.title: Combine & Garnish
steps.instruction: Pour the aromatic tadka into the rice, mix gently, and fold in juicy pomegranate seeds and fresh coriander.
steps.tip: Serve chilled with lime pickle or roasted papad.

summary: Creamy, soothing South Indian curd rice tempered with crunchy dal, ginger, curry leaves, and ruby pomegranate arils.

title: Mumbai Street-Style Pav Bhaji

steps.title: Mash Boiled Vegetables
steps.instruction: Boil potatoes, cauliflower, and green peas. Mash them thoroughly with a potato masher till smooth.
steps.tip: Smooth uniform mashing gives rich street-style texture.

steps.title: Sauté Aromatics & Veggies
steps.instruction: Melt 2 tbsp butter on a large tawa or flat kadai. Sauté chopped onions, ginger-garlic paste, and finely diced capsicum for 4-5 mins.
steps.tip: Sauté capsicum with onions for signature crunch and aroma.

steps.title: Simmer with Tomatoes & Spices
steps.instruction: Add tomato puree, Pav Bhaji masala, Kashmiri chilli powder, kasuri methi, and salt. Cook until butter starts oozing from sides.
steps.tip: Kashmiri chilli powder provides vibrant red color naturally without artificial food colors.

steps.title: Combine, Mash on Tawa & Simmer
steps.instruction: Add the mashed vegetables and 1 cup warm water. Continuously mash with potato masher on high heat while simmering for 10 mins.
steps.tip: Continuous mashing and bubbling on tawa emulsifies the butter and veggies.

steps.title: Butter Toast Pav & Serve
steps.instruction: Slit pav buns, slather with butter and a pinch of Pav Bhaji masala, and toast on hot tawa. Serve bubbling bhaji topped with butter slab, chopped onions, and lemon wedges.
steps.tip: The ultimate Mumbai street classic.

summary: Iconic Mumbai street delicacy of spicy, butter-drenched mashed vegetable gravy served with hot, crisp butter-toasted pav buns.

title: Matki Chi Usal (Spiced Moth Bean Stir Fry)

steps.title: Prepare the Main Ingredients
steps.instruction: Wash, chop, soak or pre-cook the main ingredients for Matki Chi Usal (Spiced Moth Bean Stir Fry): sprouted matki, onion, tomato, goda masala, mustard seed.
steps.tip: Cut vegetables to similar sizes so they finish together.

steps.title: Build the Masala
steps.instruction: Heat the listed cooking fat and cook the recipe’s aromatics, seeds and spices until fragrant.
steps.tip: Cook the masala until the raw aroma disappears before adding the main liquid.

steps.title: Cook Until Tender
steps.instruction: Add the recipe’s water, stock, curd or coconut base and simmer Matki Chi Usal until the main ingredient is tender and the gravy reaches the intended consistency.
steps.tip: Keep the simmer gentle once the ingredients are tender.

steps.title: Balance the Seasoning
steps.instruction: Taste and adjust only with the listed salt, souring agent, sweetener or spice.
steps.tip: Balance sour, sweet and heat at the end.

steps.title: Finish and Serve
steps.instruction: Turn off the heat, add coconut when listed, rest briefly and serve Matki Chi Usal.
steps.tip: Resting briefly lets the gravy and spices settle.

summary: Nutritious sprouted moth beans simmered in goda masala, coconut, and mild jaggery gravy.

title: Kandeshi Zunka (Dry Roasted Spicy Besan)

steps.title: Prepare Kandeshi Zunka
steps.instruction: Measure and prepare the main ingredients for Kandeshi Zunka (Dry Roasted Spicy Besan): besan, onion, garlic, lasun, green chilli.
steps.tip: Keep the main ingredient ready before starting the cooking stage.

steps.title: Cook the Main Components
steps.instruction: Cook the ingredients for Kandeshi Zunka (Dry Roasted Spicy Besan) in the order required by their cooking time, adding delicate ingredients later.
steps.tip: Watch the texture of the main ingredient as well as the clock.

steps.title: Combine and Season
steps.instruction: Combine the cooked components of Kandeshi Zunka (Dry Roasted Spicy Besan) and balance only the listed seasoning.
steps.tip: Taste near the end because cooking can concentrate seasoning.

steps.title: Finish Kandeshi Zunka
steps.instruction: Finish Kandeshi Zunka (Dry Roasted Spicy Besan) with coriander and serve at the intended texture and temperature.
steps.tip: Use the recipe’s listed finishing ingredient so this step stays specific to the dish.

summary: Dry roasted garlicky chickpea flour dish with caramelized onions and green chillies.

steps.title: Prepare the Main Ingredients
steps.instruction: Wash, chop, soak or pre-cook the main ingredients for Khandeshi Shev Bhaji (Spicy Sev Curry in Kala Masala): shev, sev, onion, dry coconut, ginger.
steps.tip: Cut vegetables to similar sizes so they finish together.

steps.title: Build the Masala

steps.instruction: Taste and adjust only with the listed salt, souring agent, sweetener or spice.
steps.tip: Balance sour, sweet and heat at the end.

steps.title: Finish and Serve

steps.tip: Resting briefly lets the gravy and spices settle.

summary: Fiery Khandeshi curry made with deeply roasted coconut-onion kala masala topped with thick spicy gathiya sev.

title: Nagpuri Patodi Rassa (Spiced Besan Rolls in Fiery Red Curry)

steps.title: Prepare the Main Ingredients
steps.instruction: Wash, chop, soak or pre-cook the main ingredients for Nagpuri Patodi Rassa (Spiced Besan Rolls in Fiery Red Curry): besan, onion, ginger, garlic, dry coconut.
steps.tip: Cut vegetables to similar sizes so they finish together.

steps.title: Build the Masala
steps.instruction: Heat the listed cooking fat and cook the recipe’s aromatics, seeds and spices until fragrant.
steps.tip: Cook the masala until the raw aroma disappears before adding the main liquid.

summary: Vidarbha delicacy of steamed and spiced besan rolls swimming in a fiery red coconut-onion rassa.

steps.tip: Cut vegetables to similar sizes so they finish together.

steps.title: Build the Masala
steps.instruction: Heat the listed cooking fat and cook the recipe’s aromatics, seeds and spices until fragrant.
steps.tip: Cook the masala until the raw aroma disappears before adding the main liquid.

steps.title: Cook Until Tender
steps.instruction: Add the recipe’s water, stock, curd or coconut base and simmer Dhabha Style Dal Palak until the main ingredient is tender and the gravy reaches the intended consistency.
steps.tip: Keep the simmer gentle once the ingredients are tender.

steps.title: Balance the Seasoning
steps.instruction: Taste and adjust only with the listed salt, souring agent, sweetener or spice.
steps.tip: Balance sour, sweet and heat at the end.

steps.title: Finish and Serve
steps.instruction: Turn off the heat, add coriander when listed, rest briefly and serve Dhabha Style Dal Palak.
steps.tip: Resting briefly lets the gravy and spices settle.

summary: Wholesome everyday lentil curry enriched with fresh chopped spinach and a smoking hot garlic ghee tadka.

title: Refreshing Spiced Masala Chaas (Indian Buttermilk)

steps.title: Prepare the Base
steps.instruction: Measure curd, dahi, sour curd, roasted cumin powder, black salt. Whisk the main liquid base—curd, dahi, sour curd—until smooth.
steps.tip: Use chilled ingredients and whisk until there are no lumps.

steps.title: Blend the Flavours
steps.instruction: Add the remaining listed ingredients and blend or churn until evenly combined.
steps.tip: Taste before adding more seasoning so the drink stays balanced.

steps.title: Adjust Consistency
steps.instruction: Add the recipe liquid gradually until the drink reaches the intended pourable consistency.
steps.tip: Add liquid gradually; over-thinning is difficult to correct.

steps.title: Chill and Serve
steps.instruction: Pour into glasses and finish with mint leaves. Serve chilled.
steps.tip: This recipe is served cool; do not use the generic hot-serving method.

summary: Cooling, digestive Indian buttermilk churned with mint, coriander, ginger, green chillies, and roasted cumin.

title: Traditional Danedar Besan Ladoo

steps.title: Roast the Base
steps.instruction: Roast besan, gram flour over low-medium heat, stirring until aromatic and evenly coloured.
steps.tip: Low heat prevents flour or rava from burning before it roasts through.

steps.title: Add Fat and Flavour
steps.instruction: Add the listed fat and cardamom or other flavouring, then roast briefly until nutty.
steps.tip: The mixture should be moist enough to bind, not greasy.

steps.title: Sweeten and Bind
steps.instruction: Mix in the listed sweetener and nuts: bura sugar, powdered sugar, cardamom, cashews, almonds.
steps.tip: Cool until comfortable to handle before shaping.

steps.title: Shape the Ladoo
steps.instruction: Press small portions firmly between your palms and roll into smooth ladoos.
steps.tip: If crumbly, use a little of the recipe’s listed warm fat or milk rather than water.

summary: Mouth-melting festive dessert made by slow-roasting coarse gram flour in golden ghee with fragrant green cardamom.

title: Instant Poha Kheer / Payasam

steps.title: Prepare the Main Ingredient
steps.instruction: Rinse or roast poha, milk as appropriate for Instant Poha Kheer / Payasam.
steps.tip: Roasting grains or vermicelli first removes a raw taste and improves aroma.

steps.title: Simmer the Milk
steps.instruction: Bring the listed milk to a gentle simmer and cook poha until tender and the milk begins to thicken.
steps.tip: Stir the bottom frequently so the milk does not scorch.

steps.title: Sweeten and Perfume
steps.instruction: Add jaggery, sugar, ghee, cardamom, cashews, raisins according to the ingredient list and cook until the flavourings are fragrant.
steps.tip: Add delicate saffron and nuts near the end.

steps.title: Set and Serve
steps.instruction: Turn off the heat while the pudding is slightly loose; it thickens as it cools. Finish with the listed nuts or saffron.
steps.tip: Cooling changes the texture, so do not over-reduce the pudding on the stove.

summary: Delightful 10-minute Indian dessert made of flattened rice simmered in sweetened milk with cardamom and ghee-roasted nuts.

steps.tip: The condiment should taste balanced before serving.
